title: SimNode state machine and lifecycle
description: Verify SimNode state machine handles all transitions correctly: idle, tx, rx, sleep. Ensure channel hopping and TDMA scheduler integration works. File: python/src/lichen/sim/node.py
close_reason: Already fixed: SimNode state machine is fully implemented with IDLE/TX/RX_WAIT states and comprehensive test coverage (31 tests pass). The bead mentioned 'sleep' state but this is a hardware abstraction (SX127x RegOpMode); the simulator correctly uses IDLE for inactive radio. Channel hopping via synchronized_hop_channel() and TDMA scheduler are integrated with 88 additional tests passing. All transitions are validated: IDLE<->TX, IDLE<->RX_WAIT, TX<->RX_WAIT, plus invalid transition rejection.
